name: Smart Axiata
description: Smart Axiata is one of Cambodia's leading telecommunications companies and a strategic industry partner of ITC, supporting technology education, internships, and research collaboration.

name: Wing Bank
description: Wing Bank is a leading digital financial services provider in Cambodia and an industry partner supporting FinTech education and student internship programs at ITC.

name: Institut Polytechnique de Paris
description: A leading French engineering school and longstanding academic partner of ITC. The partnership enables student and faculty exchange, joint research programs, and co-supervised theses.

name: Agence Universitaire de la Francophonie (AUF)
description: AUF supports Francophone higher education institutions worldwide. Their partnership with ITC provides scholarship funding, digital library access, and faculty development grants.

name: Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS)
description: The Ministry of Education provides regulatory oversight and collaborative support for ITC's academic programs, curriculum development, and national education initiatives.
